summary: Cheche Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, with an accompanying press release announcing the commercial launch of ABAO Agent, an AI-powered intelligent underwriting solution for auto insurance renewal scenarios. The filing describes a product launch and strategic evolution from a digital insurance transaction platform to an AI-driven insurtech company, with no mention of any proposed transaction, board recommendation, or deal mechanics. This is a routine current report on a business development, not a special situation filing.
